authorization: User requested a comprehensive combat presentation benchmark and enemy/Boss motion and sound upgrades.
request_policy: One paid POST per new receipt; uncertain requests are never automatically resubmitted.

blade.prompt: Original isolated insect-fantasy game sound. No music, melody, voice, electronic beep or ambience. A swift thin metal needle or scythe slicing air: sharp airy swish, fine edge hiss and a tiny cloth flutter. A weapon swing only, no impact or hit.

heavy.prompt: Original isolated insect-fantasy game sound. No music, melody, voice, electronic beep or ambience. A heavy broad bladed weapon swinging with the body's weight: low airy whoom followed by a dry metallic edge sweep. Organic and weighty, not a cinematic explosion. No hit impact.

claw.prompt: Original isolated insect-fantasy game sound. No music, melody, voice, electronic beep or ambience. An insect's chitin jaw and claw snapping forward: dry articulated shell clicks leading into a compact cutting air swish. No gore, voice or damage impact.

wing.prompt: Original isolated insect-fantasy game sound. No music, melody, voice, electronic beep or ambience. A quick insect wingbeat surging into a diving pass: fluttering papery wings, a focused rushing air sweep and a short airy tail. No crash or impact.

seed.prompt: Original isolated insect-fantasy game sound. No music, melody, voice, electronic beep or ambience. A small organic seed-pod releasing its load: a soft elastic pop and dry grainy spore puff with a brief seed rattle. Single release, no explosion or continuous spray.

root.prompt: Original isolated insect-fantasy game sound. No music, melody, voice, electronic beep or ambience. A gnarled wooden root and reed staff releasing stored tension: close fibrous creak, compact wooden crack and light dry leaf movement. Short organic attack release, no long ambience.

bell.prompt: Original isolated insect-fantasy game sound. No music, melody, voice, electronic beep or ambience. An old small bronze shell releasing a brief magical pulse: a tactile muted bronze knock, a short diffuse glassy air shimmer, quickly damping away. Non-musical, no tune, electronic beep or giant cinematic bell.

impact.prompt: Original isolated insect-fantasy game sound. No music, melody, voice, electronic beep or ambience. A compact physical contact in an insect battle: a dull body thud layered with a brittle shell tick and short cloth rustle. Dry, punchy, restrained, no gore or human voice, no weapon whoosh.

prep_light.prompt: Original isolated insect-fantasy game sound. No music, melody, voice, electronic beep or ambience. An insect fighter drawing a light weapon back: subtle close cloth stretch, chitin joint tension and a tiny handle creak. Quiet anticipation only; no swing, impact or alert beep.

prep_heavy.prompt: Original isolated insect-fantasy game sound. No music, melody, voice, electronic beep or ambience. A heavy insect warrior bracing to swing: low leather and wooden grip strain with a short restrained metallic tension scrape. Quiet physical anticipation only; no swing, impact or boom.

prep_cast.prompt: Original isolated insect-fantasy game sound. No music, melody, voice, electronic beep or ambience. An organic pod and dry leaf vessel tightening before a release: a close soft inhaling air draw, fibrous stretch and faint husk rattle. Quiet preparation only, no actual projectile release or synthetic charge tone.
